body.p: After , . Owns src/xslt_lower.c, src/xslt_lower_internal.h, tests/xslt_lower_test.c. Lowering part: sequence constructors, literal result elements (namespace fixup, exclude-result-prefixes, xsl:namespace-alias), xsl:element, attribute, text, value-of (separator), comment, processing-instruction, namespace, document, copy, copy-of, sequence, xsl:map, map-entry, array, record (4.0), TVTs, whitespace text nodes. Done when insn-lre, element, attribute, text, value-of, copy, construct-node, sequence ≥ 85% under 4.15. Spec: XSLT 4.0 "Creating Nodes and Sequences". Done 2026-10-19 (): src/xslt_lower.c, src/xslt_lower_construct.c, src/xslt_simple_content.c, src/xslt_lower_internal.h, tests/xslt_lower_test.c; xsl:record in the AST (src/xslt_read.c).
